data.title: 陈千语 · 还差最后一颗螺丝
data.description: 旧收音机的外壳摊在工作垫上。千语扶着后盖拧紧螺丝，抬头听了听刚恢复的广播声，笑得像完成了一场小挑战。
data.promptProse: Chen Qianyu sits at a hobby workbench in sand-colored overalls and a brick-red T-shirt. She holds a radio back panel steady while tightening its final screw with a small screwdriver, smiling at the restored sound. A desk lamp lights the rubber work mat and scattered screws.
data.animaCaption: The screwdriver meets a screw in the radio casing while her other hand holds the panel still.
data.action: 用螺丝刀固定旧收音机后盖
